value.rationale: A fixed accumulated contact budget is a physically natural surface-reaction threshold. Known mean-minimization is insufficient for reliability design: the exact variance optimization has a unique strictly larger rate by universal factor 1.771342..., while relative variance has a third distinct monotone design objective. Global uniqueness, not an arbitrary finite numerical improvement, makes the distinction sharp.
